measurement_context: Three sequential baseline runs, then candidate build, then three sequential candidate runs. result: No repeatable median CPU-frame improvement established; the candidate is removed from production. The median of per-run 500-node CPU-frame medians is 32.929584 ms before and 33.23925 ms with the candidate. Socket moves remain unchanged and eligibility checks add work.
